title: Air reference: a ball, a gas and weight
author: American Chemical Society
citation: Chapter 1, lesson 5 lesson plan (PDF), pages 1 to 3; the unit plan calls it the Air reference
difficulty: teacher reading; nothing in it is printed for children
why: Checks the idea that air has weight and that a pumped ball gains grams
status: read 2026-11-20 page by page (pages 1 to 3, in a browser): the summary and procedure match the unit's use. A deflated basketball is weighed, pumped full and weighed again; the inflated ball has the greater mass, so gas is matter because it has mass and takes up space. Earlier check (2026-11-18) went through the lesson page only.
